title: Drop Side Cribs Recalled by Caramia Furniture Due to Fall and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The slats on the cribs drop-side can detach from the top and bottom rails, posing fall and entrapment hazards to the child. Units: About 1,000.

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Glitter Tea Lights Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The flame from the tea lights can ignite the glitter on the candle, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 37,000 United States and 3,000 in Canada.

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Santa Tea Light Holders Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The flame from tea lights can ignite these tea light holders, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 61,500 in the United States and 5,500 in Canada.

title: Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard Prompts Recall of Mattress Sets by Mattress World
summary: The mattress sets fail to meet the mandatory federal open flame standard and pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 750.

title: Bicycles and Framesets Recalled By Seattle Bike Supply Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle's fork legs can separate from the fork crown and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of serious injury if the rider falls. Units: About 350.

title: Lenmar Enterprises Recalls Rechargeable Batteries Sold for Cordless Phones Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The rechargeable batteries can overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,400.

title: Rockler Companies Recalls LED Light Kits Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: Defective wiring in the light kits can cause the battery pack to overheat and explode, posing a risk of burn and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 2,200.

title: Children's "Big Rex and Friends" Cloth Books Recalled Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: A red plastic dot sewn in the book contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 204,000.

title: Home Improvement Books Recalled by Oxmoor House Due to Faulty Wiring Instructions; Shock or Fire Hazard to Consumers
summary: The books contain errors in the technical diagrams and wiring instructions that could lead consumers to incorrectly install or repair electrical wiring, posing an electrical shock or fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 951,000.

title: Acer Recalls Notebook Computers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: An internal microphone wire under the palm rest can short circuit and overheat. This poses a potential burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 22,000.

title: Ammonia Recalled by OnLine Packaging Due to Chemical Hazard
summary: The bottle, which is labeled as containing ammonia, actually contains household bleach. The mislabeling of the bottles can pose a chemical hazard to consumers. If bleach is accidentally mixed with ammonia or acid, irritating or toxic gases could be produced. Units: About 75 bottles.

title: Gas Cans Recalled by No-Spill; Containers Can Leak and Create Fire Hazard
summary: The gas containers can leak fuel at the black plastic collar where the spout connects to the can, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers Units: About 7,500.

title: Primal Vantage Recalls Plastic Tree Steps Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Fall Units: About 16,000.

title: Jide Trading Recalls Toy Military Figure Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The surface paint on the toy contains excessive levels of lead violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: 2100.

title: Sagittarius Sporting Goods Recalls Gas Grills Sold at Lowe's Stores Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The flexible rubber hose on the LP gas tank can come into contact with burner box, causing the hose to melt and rupture when the grill is lit. This poses a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 10,000.

title: FAF Inc. Recalls Children's Necklaces Sold Exclusively at Walmart Stores Due to High Levels of Cadmium
summary: The recalled necklaces contain high levels of cadmium. Cadmium is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 55,000.

title: Rechargeable Batteries Used with Touch Panels for Audio/Visual Systems Recalled by AMX Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: A defect in the battery can cause the battery pack to overheat and rupture. This poses a fire and burn hazard to consumers Units: About 115,000.

title: Starbucks Recalls Glass Water Bottles Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass water bottle and/or its stopper can shatter when the consumer is removing or inserting the stopper, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 11,000 in the United States and 1,200 in Canada.

title: Summit Treestands Recalls Hunting Tree Stand Brackets Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The tree stand can unexpectedly detach from the tree when the brackets fail, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,800.

title: Liebherr Recalls Built-In Refrigerators Due to Injury Hazard; Door Can Detach
summary: The refrigerator's door can detach, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,700.

title: Regal Lager Announces Recall to Repair CYBEX Strollers; Risk of Fingertip Amputation and Laceration Hazards
summary: The stroller's hinge mechanism poses a fingertip amputation and laceration hazard to the child when the consumer is unfolding/opening the stroller. Units: About 1,100 in the United States and 90 in Canada.

title: Yamaha Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Loss of Steering Control
summary: A bolt in the right front A arm can loosen in the suspension/steering system, resulting in the sudden loss of steering control. This poses a risk of injury or death to riders. Units: About 2,500.

title: Zippo Recalls Candle Lighters Due to Burn Hazard
summary: Lighters can produce an excessive flame when adjusted to maximum flame setting, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 17,500.

title: Boy's Three-Piece Santa Sets Recalled by Macy's Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Loose buttons on the suit's jacket may easily detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 9,600.

title: Horse Toy Figures Recalled by Blip Toys Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The surface paint coating on the horse contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 15,000.

title: RadioShack Recalls Knight Hawk Toy Helicopters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The battery housing under the helicopter canopy can overheat while charging, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 20,800.

title: BSH Home Appliances Corp. Expands Recall of Thermador Built-In Ovens Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The ovens can have gaps in the insulation where overheating can occur and when used in the self-cleaning mode it can cause nearby cabinets to catch fire. This poses a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 37,000 (This recall was first announced in June 2007).

title: Connector Kits Used with Sonitrol Access Control Modules Recalled; Failure Could Lead to Entrapment in an Emergency
summary: The pin connector can fail and prevent a door from being unlocked from the inside, posing an entrapment hazard to consumers. This failure can lead to the inability to vacate a location in an emergency. Units: About 6,500.

title: Johnson Health Tech North America Recalls Horizon Fitness and LIVESTRONG™ Fitness Elliptical Trainers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The foot pedal can become disengaged, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 18,000.

title: Lifetime Brands Recalls Fruit and Vegetable Choppers Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold at Sam's Club
summary: Pieces of the chopper's metal blades can break off during use and fall into food being prepared in the chopper, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,000.

title: Lysol Steam Cleaning Mop Recalled by Conair Corp. Due to Burn and Laceration Hazards
summary: Hot water mixed with Lysol can forcefully spurt out and rupture the housing unit, posing a burn hazard and a laceration hazard to consumers from the broken housing unit. Units: About 162,000.

title: Graco Recalls Strollers Due to Fingertip Amputation and Laceration Hazards
summary: The hinges on the stroller's canopy pose a fingertip amputation and laceration hazard to the child when the consumer is opening or closing the canopy. Units: About 1.5 million.

title: Dorel Asia Recalls To Replace Cribs; Pose Strangulation and Suffocation Hazards: One infant death reported, 10 injuries to infants
summary: The drop side hardware can fail causing the drop side to detach from the crib. When the drop side detaches it creates a space in which an infant or toddler can become entrapped and suffocate or strangle. title: MooreCo Recalls Ergonomic Office Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The legs of the chair can break, posing fall hazard to the user. Units: About 700.

title: Rifle Crossbow Recalled by Master Cutlery; Crossbow Can Discharge Unexpectedly
summary: The trigger mechanism becomes loose after 30 shots. When the safety mechanism is moved to the fire position, the crossbow will automatically discharge on its own. Units: About 300.
